question: List the bowlers (including their ID, first name, and last name), match number, game number, handicap score, tournament date, and location for only those bowlers who have won games with a handicap score of 190 or less at all three venues: Thunderbird Lanes, Totem Lanes, and Bolero Lanes. Only include the specific game records where they won with a handicap score of 190 or less at these three locations.
sql:
WITH bowlers_at_thunderbird AS (
    SELECT bs.BowlerID, bs.GameNumber, bs.HandiCapScore, bs.WonGame, t.TourneyLocation
    FROM Bowler_Scores bs
    JOIN Tourney_Matches tm ON bs.MatchID = tm.MatchID
    JOIN Tournaments t ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
    WHERE t.TourneyLocation = 'Thunderbird Lanes'
      AND bs.WonGame = 1
      AND bs.HandiCapScore <= 190
),
bowlers_at_totem AS (
    SELECT bs.BowlerID, bs.GameNumber, bs.HandiCapScore, bs.WonGame, t.TourneyLocation
    FROM Bowler_Scores bs
    JOIN Tourney_Matches tm ON bs.MatchID = tm.MatchID
    JOIN Tournaments t ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
    WHERE t.TourneyLocation = 'Totem Lanes'
      AND bs.WonGame = 1
      AND bs.HandiCapScore <= 190
),
bowlers_at_bolero AS (
    SELECT bs.BowlerID, bs.GameNumber, bs.HandiCapScore, bs.WonGame, t.TourneyLocation
    FROM Bowler_Scores bs
    JOIN Tourney_Matches tm ON bs.MatchID = tm.MatchID
    JOIN Tournaments t ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
    WHERE t.TourneyLocation = 'Bolero Lanes'
      AND bs.WonGame = 1
      AND bs.HandiCapScore <= 190
),
qualifying_bowlers AS (
    SELECT bt.BowlerID
    FROM bowlers_at_thunderbird bt
    INTERSECT
    SELECT bt2.BowlerID
    FROM bowlers_at_totem bt2
    INTERSECT
    SELECT bt3.BowlerID
    FROM bowlers_at_bolero bt3
)
SELECT b.BowlerID, b.BowlerFirstName, b.BowlerLastName, bs.GameNumber, bs.HandiCapScore, t.TourneyDate, t.TourneyLocation
FROM qualifying_bowlers qb
JOIN Bowlers b ON qb.BowlerID = b.BowlerID
JOIN Bowler_Scores bs ON qb.BowlerID = bs.BowlerID
JOIN Tourney_Matches tm ON bs.MatchID = tm.MatchID
JOIN Tournaments t ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
WHERE t.TourneyLocation IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes')
  AND bs.WonGame = 1
  AND bs.HandiCapScore <= 190
ORDER BY b.BowlerFirstName, b.BowlerLastName, t.TourneyLocation, bs.GameNumber
